bosses.name: Mad Bull, Dragner, Ifrit, Icarus, Baldo, Charon, Lobo, Egil, Forron, Seravi, Sandalphon, Czernobog
bosses.strategy:
Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this
one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy.

Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be
weaker as well, and vice versa.

If you want to use the Mind's Eye, just fuse into Amon and wail on them
for a few rounds, making sure to heal if necessary.

If you don't want to use the Mind's Eye, fuse into the highest level
monster that is the opposite class of the one you're fighting. Make sure
to keep yourself healed if you fear that you'll be taken down fairly
easily.

You most likely have all of Yuri's Level 2 Fusions already, but there's a
chance you won't have all of the Level 3 Fusions. To get the ultimate Fusion,
the Seraphic Radiance, we need to have every other Fusion, including Amon.

   Unlocking the ???? attacks
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
To unlock the higher level Fusion's ???? attacks, Yuri must be Berserk as that
Fusion. Once he is, he'll cast it on the enemy, and will know it from then on.

The best way to do this is to equip the Small Jug so 2 SP are taken per round,
and the Monk Earrings so your SP is lower. Fight a battle, then go to the
Graveyard and fight the Malice. Fuse Yuri into the Fusion you want, then keep
Defending until Yuri goes Berserk, obliterating the Evil with your new spell.

  NOTE     You do not need to know the ???? spells to obtain the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   SeraphicRadiance.

Now, on to the next side quest.
